cohort: The study included 101 children and adolescents diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
finding: Four out of 101 (4%) children and adolescents with ASD were identified with CYP27A1 gene mutations indicative of CTX, and all mutant cases had comorbid oppositional defiant disorder and behavioral disorders.
cross-section timing: At the time of study assessment for children and adolescents with ASD
